assessment.description:
Initial assessment (session 1 only). Records the placement *event* — what
was elicited and the decision reached. The persisted placement *result*
lives in learner-profile.yaml initial_placement (schemas/learner-profile.schema.yaml).
Field mapping: placement_decision.level -> initial_placement.level,
placement_decision.confidence -> initial_placement.confidence,
reading_check.comprehension -> initial_placement.reading_result.

learner_report.description: What the learner said about it

skill_updates.description: Free-form skill-map deltas prompted by this review

verification_result.description: What the tutor observed when testing the claim

assignments.description: Homework assignments for before next session

dialect_advisory.description:
Required when the assignment matches the dialect-mismatch trigger matrix in
input-orchestration.md Section 1 Step 2 (mixed/neutral resource + voseo/vosotros
target_dialect, or peninsular resource + non-es-ES target_dialect).

estimated_minutes.description: Minutes the learner should expect to spend

narrow_topic_aligned.description: True if this assignment aligns with the week's narrow topic (input-orchestration.md Section 1 Step 5).

notes.description: Free-text note or prompt for the assignment

priority.description: Assignment priority (required = core, recommended = should-do, bonus = optional)

resource.description: Resource title from curriculum/media-bank.yaml or resources/resource-catalog.yaml

retrieval_target.description: Prior concept to revisit in this assignment (e.g. 'include 2 ser/estar sentences')

target_skill.description: Which skill-map entry this assignment supports

task.description: Human-readable description of the assignment (input-orchestration.md Section 1 Step 5; docs/system-design.md).

type.description: Assignment type — anki, writing, listening, reading, drill, journal, etc.

decision_engine_trace.description: Records why the tutor chose this session's focus — scoring details from concept selection

candidates_scored.description: Number of concepts evaluated by the decision engine

override_reason.description: Null unless manual override; record reason if so

selected_primary.description: Concept ID selected as primary focus

selected_secondary.description: Concept ID selected as secondary focus

top_candidates.description: Top-scoring candidates with individual dimension scores: {id, NEED, GAP, DECAY, TOPIC, INTEREST, VARIETY, TOTAL}

gap_days.description: Days since last session (0 if consecutive)

homework_load_rating.description: D-10/LOAD-04: Learner self-report on PRIOR session's homework load. Captured in Review & Warm-up (CLAUDE.md L96). Separate from session_difficulty_rating. Drives D-11 tiered daily_target adjustment via check_daily_target_tier_drift in validate-state.py.

input_reviewed.description: Input comprehension debrief entries. NOTE: comprehension_assessment here (per-session debrief) feeds the running receptive_skills.comprehension_quality in skill-map (CLAUDE.md State Updates step 3) — the two are intentionally named differently (event log vs. cumulative state).

comprehension_assessment.description: Depth of comprehension demonstrated in the debrief

level_at_time.description: Learner's level when the input was assigned (e.g. L2)

production_gaps_observed.description: Words the learner reached for but couldn't produce

interleaved_concepts.description: Prior concepts woven into primary concept practice

quality_notes.description: Coherence, complexity, improvement from prior entries

autonomy_readiness.description: Observations about whether learner is ready for more control

calibration_note.description: If self-assessment diverges from actual performance

mood.description: motivated, neutral, frustrated, tired, excited, anxious

notes.description: Free-text observation about the learner's state (used e.g. in the first-session log)

self_assessment.description: What they said about how they're feeling about progress

new_anki_cards.description:
QR-R3: Count of NEW Anki cards added this session. Reviewing or
re-activating existing cards does NOT count. Guardrail enforced by
check-session-log.py (check_new_anki_cards): a value > 10 FAILs the
commit. Absent/0 on pre-QR-R3 logs, which passes.

new_grammar_concepts_introduced.description:
QR-R3: Grammar concept IDs (skill-map keys, e.g. A-02-ser-vs-estar)
introduced for the first time this session. Consolidation/review of
already-seen concepts does NOT belong here. Guardrail enforced by
check-session-log.py (check_new_grammar_concepts): length > 1 FAILs the
commit (CLAUDE.md "Never introduce more than 1 new grammar concept per
session"). Empty/absent passes.

avoid.description: What NOT to do tomorrow and why

l1_interference_to_preempt.description: Predicted transfer errors to address proactively

placement_skipped_sessions.description: Onboarding session numbers skipped due to placement (first-session.md §7: Late-A skips 01-04; Early-B+ logs all 10). Empty/absent for a true-beginner / Early-A first session.

recasts.description: D-05: per-event recast log. Empty list = positive assertion of 'no recasts occurred.' Required when session contains Stage 3/4, fluency, or conversation practice (see check-session-log.py D-06).

activity_stage.description: Activity stage when the recast occurred

uptake.description: Whether learner incorporated the corrected form

errors_noted.description: Per-error records observed during the activity

category.description: grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, gender, fluency, cultural

concept.description: Which skill-map entry this maps to

l1_interference_noted.description: Whether any L1 interference errors were observed

observations.description: Free-text summary of what the tutor observed

type.description: Activity type — conversation, grammar-drill, translation, fluency-drill, writing-review, etc.

session_type.description:
Session type. Includes 9 base types (standard, micro, weekly-review,
phase-transition, return, first-session, onboarding, sprint, fluency)
plus 2 overlay strings (onboarding-with-return-overlay,
maintenance-with-weekly-review) and 2 router-only types (maintenance,
placement-validation). The 4 added values mirror scripts/route_session.py
return strings so the session log can persist whatever the router
decided. Audit C-3: prior enum omitted these, breaking the canary doc's
`route_session.py state/` verification step.

skill_map_updates.description: Assessment updates to apply to skill-map

field.description: Field changed — status, error_rate_drills, error_rate_production, error_trend, etc.
